technical.summary: Mixed momentum signals with short-term bullish indicators (AO cross, force index) offset by intermediate-term weakness (below 50-day MAs, Ichimoku cloud) and lack of trend confirmation; moderate risk entry with limited confluence.

fundamental.summary: UNP shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 90 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals with market fear (38/100) presenting potential contrarian opportunity, but congressional activity is stale and inconclusive with no recent directional conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (342.4), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures multinationals, with earnings event in 90 days adding execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum crossovers (AO, force index) and supertrend bullish signal suggest immediate upside potential with price near support at 192.15.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising DXY), price below both 50-day MAs, Ichimoku below cloud, zero fundamental conviction, and 90-day earnings risk create a hostile environment that overwhelms weak technical signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum crossovers (AO, force index) and supertrend bullish offer tactical entry at support, but macro environment is severely hostile with VIX in crisis and yield curve flat.
decision.primary_risk: Macro headwinds (VIX 342.4, flat yield curve, rising DXY) combined with 90-day earnings event and price below 50-day MAs create high probability of reversal before momentum signals mature.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
